content:
Union Public Service Commission has issued an exam-city, schedule or admit-card related update for UPSC Civil Services IAS Mains Admit Card 2026 – Out.

Download the hall ticket or city intimation only from the official portal. Carry a printed copy and photo ID to the venue.

How to download

  1. Open upsconline.nic.in
  2. Use the Admit Card / Exam City login
  3. Enter registration number and password or date of birth
  4. Print the PDF and check shift, city and reporting time
